items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: my childhood acquaintances were Nat King Cole and Judy Garland... So without knowing who they were, I was being imbued with this culture of music

ctx.x: Wow, where do you go from there?

Where do you go from there? And my childhood acquaintances were Nat King Cole and Judy Garland and the Andrews Sisters and Sophie Tucker, Jack Benny. So without knowing who they were, I was being imbued with this culture of music, you know, show business, music. And it just seemed like a natural thing to me. And then I would see my uncles playing music on television, because they appeared a lot on British T.V. And somewhere it was always, well you know I think I want to do that. It was never any question that I…
Were your parents on board with that direction they saw you going in?
